what_is_closed: the openly accessible Bosak et al. primary PDF is archived with a reproducible hash
the room-temperature single-crystal graphite elastic tensor and reported bulk-modulus row are transcribed with source locators
the hexagonal compliance-to-hydrostatic-bulk formula is explicit and independently reproducible
the distinction between an IXS elastic/dynamic bulk comparator and isothermal K_T is recorded
major_result.derivation_class: source transcription plus unit-aware inversion of the declared hexagonal elastic tensor; no UET derivation
major_result.observable: room-temperature single-crystal graphite elastic bulk-modulus comparator
major_result.dependency_unlocked: source-locked graphite elastic bulk comparator only; no K_T, volumetric c_v, alpha_Phi_K, transport, Core, Gravity, or Galaxy unlock
major_result.claim_boundary: This is a source-traceable elastic bulk-modulus comparator. It is not an isothermal K_T calibration, not a Ding/HOPG material match, not UET transport, and not an alpha_Phi_K calibration.

source.title: Elasticity of single-crystalline graphite: Inelastic x-ray scattering study
source_locators: PDF p. 1: abstract and IXS elastic-modulus method
PDF pp. 1-2: kish graphite sample and acoustic-phonon sound-velocity method
PDF p. 3 / Table II: present experimental C11, C12, C13, C33, C44, C66, and B rows
source.temperature_scope: room temperature; the source abstract and Table II do not provide a resolved temperature series
source.method: inelastic x-ray scattering; acoustic-phonon initial slopes; Christoffel equation
source_limitations: C13 is described by the source as poorly defined because of graphite anisotropy
the reported B is an elastic/dynamic comparator from IXS-derived constants, not a declared thermal isothermal K_T measurement
the sample is not demonstrated to be the Ding TTG sample or the NIST AXM-5Q1 reference

elastic_tensor.symmetry: hexagonal graphite; five independent stiffness constants
elastic_tensor.uncertainty_interpretation: Table II parenthesized uncertainties; covariance is not supplied and no independent-component propagation is used as the source B uncertainty

reported_bulk_modulus.source_locator: PDF p. 3 / Table II / Present expt.

secondary_context_not_consumed.source_locator: PDF p. 3 / Table II / Previous expt. / XRD
secondary_context_not_consumed.role: context only; the primary XRD source is not archived in this package and the value is not used in the reconstruction

isothermal_boundary.required_thermal_relation: K_T = K_S * C_v/C_p when the elastic measurement is identified as adiabatic K_S and the same-state Cp/Cv are available

claim_boundary: The package supplies a source-locked room-temperature graphite elastic bulk comparator and a reproducible tensor route. It does not supply isothermal K_T, Cp-to-Cv closure, Ding PBTE C_src(T), base Phi-to-energy mapping, alpha_Phi_K, transport, SK/KMS, entropy, or global UET closure.
